scope: Raw input definitions and source QA only; no new target points, BPS or bonus.

times_tackled.rule: Explicit count including source-stored zeros. No dispossessed/dribble proxy.

saves_outside_box.rule: Explicit shot-origin outside-box saves. Not saves minus inside-box saves.

legacy_net_tackles.raw_signed_formula: won - (total - won) = 2*won - total, only when both counts are explicit, integer, nonnegative and won<=total
legacy_net_tackles.definition_basis: Opta partitions legal ball-winning tackles by subsequent possession: won and lost. Challenge lost is a failed challenge, not the possession outcome of a tackle.
legacy_net_tackles.example: Kante 2018-04-08: published net 3; archive total=3, won=3, challengeLost=1. Supports possession-outcome definition; his published recoveries 10 differ from archive 11, so this is not a full independent match validation.
legacy_net_tackles.bps_clipping: NOT QUALIFIED. Keep signed raw counter. Do not assume negative BPS or silently clip before old-season component qualification.

line_clearances.event_candidate: Types 10/12 with explicit qualifier 14. Candidate event zeros are not approved observed zeros.
line_clearances.reason: Agreement for positive values does not demonstrate complete negative/qualifier reporting across seasons. Three mapped fixtures have no events; other counters show event/stats revision differences.

event_dictionary.authority: Published parser, not a provider-certified dictionary. Event counts are corroboration/diagnostics.

source_quality_limits: Archive and Premier League controls share Opta ancestry.
Fresh 28-row sample selected before primary requests, but purposely stratified, not random or a scoring holdout.
Cell-level primary agreement is distinguished from reviewed field mappings.
Explicit counter/event disagreements stay open. No global NA-to-zero rule.
FPL values override external differences and are never patched by this audit.
